description: Source code for managing MCP servers, including discovery, starting, stopping, and status monitoring of MCP server instances via stdio bridges and HTTP processes.

classes.name: MCPServerConfig
classes.description: Configuration data class for MCP server settings.

classes.name: MCPServerProcess
classes.description: Data class representing a running MCP server process and its state.

classes.name: MCPManager
classes.description: Main class for discovering, starting, stopping, and monitoring MCP servers.

methods.name: discover_mcp_servers
methods.description: Discovers MCP server configurations from the filesystem.

methods.name: _get_next_available_port
methods.description: Finds the next available network port for starting a server.

methods.name: _detect_transport
methods.description: Detects the transport type ('stdio' or 'http') from a server configuration.

methods.name: _start_stdio_server
methods.description: Starts an MCP server using stdio bridge asynchronously.

methods.name: _start_http_server
methods.description: Starts an HTTP MCP server asynchronously.

methods.name: start_server
methods.description: Starts an MCP server based on its configuration.

methods.name: start_all_servers
methods.description: Discovers and starts all MCP servers.

methods.name: get_server_status
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a specific MCP server by alias.

methods.name: get_all_status
methods.description: Retrieves the status of all MCP servers.

methods.name: stop_server
methods.description: Stops a specific MCP server by alias.

methods.name: start_server_by_alias
methods.description: Starts an MCP server by its alias.

methods.name: restart_server
methods.description: Restarts an MCP server by alias.

methods.name: shutdown_all
methods.description: Stops all MCP servers and cleans up resources.
